# HieraDet (SAM 2)

**Category:** ViT · **Code:**
[`timm/models/hieradet_sam2.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/hieradet_sam2.py)
· **Architectures:** 5 · **Pretrained weights:** 8 (0 with ImageNet-1k results)

HieraDet, the Hiera based image encoder of Segment Anything 2 (SAM 2), with windowed attention and windowed position
embeddings.

## Papers

* [SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.00714)
* [Hiera: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer without the Bells-and-Whistles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.00989)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('sam2_hiera_base_plus.fb_r896', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`HieraDet` with `sam2_hiera_tiny` at 256), other
architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for details.
